'''Will Scotian'''<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|type=ucs|num=75144|name=Snowspeeder}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ESB" /> He survived the [[Battle of Hoth]] and continued flying after being recruited into [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] by [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson]].<ref name="Rendezvous Point" />

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 ABY]],<ref name="date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] take place in [[3 ABY]].</ref> he was among the rebel forces stationed in [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]] when it came under [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] by the Empire. Scotian lent over the [[laser cannon]] of an [[X-wing starfighter]] while listening to a briefing by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in Echo Base's hangar where she explained that the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|pilots]] present would be responsible for escorting the rebel [[GR-75 medium transport]]s past the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial fleet]] above Hoth. The rebels of Echo Base then managed to successfully escape from the Empire, although not without casualties.<ref name="ESB" />

Shortly after the evacuation of Hoth, Scotian was recruited by Commander [[Wedge Antilles]] into the newly reformed [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]. He was assigned the [[callsign]] [[Red Eight]] and flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] as flight leader in an [[Attack on an asteroid mining station|attack]] on a nearby [[pirate]] base, that threatened the safety of the Alliance's rendezvous point. His wingmates during the attack were [[Ix Ixstra]] and [[Cinda Tarheel]], and his flight's job was to run interference, covering Antilles' flight, who would hit targets on the landing field. His wingmate Ixtra however, was killed.<ref name="Rendezvous Point" />

==Personality and traits==
Scotian had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and fair skin and wore an orange [[Clothing|flight suit]] on Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> Scotian was a respected pilot who had flown with Antilles and Janson prior, making him one of the first choices by the pair as they began to rebuild Red Squadron. Scotian was later named a flight leader.<ref name="Rendezvous Point" />

==Behind the scenes==
Will Scotian's first appearance in [[canon]] was in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], though unnamed.<ref name="ESB" /> The character's name was established in canon by the [[LEGO]] [[LEGO Ultimate Collector's Series|Ultimate Collector's Series Snowspeeder]] set released in [[2017]].<ref name="LEGO" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Scotian first appeared in the [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']] by [[Steve Perry]],<ref name="SOE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> with his surname being established in the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and released in the same year.<ref name="SOE sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The character was retroactively established as one of the pilots in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' by the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] section of [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]], which was released in [[December]] [[2013]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>
